description: Check one web link: it is followed safely server-side, tested for look-alike domains, domain age, sender rules, and the URLhaus known-bad list. Returns the same verdict, checks, certificate and share link as check_message.

subscriptionCode.description: Optional subscription code (Personal Pro / Team). The check draws on the plan’s monthly credit allowance instead of the free daily credits.

url.description: The full link to check, starting with http:// or https://.
